meta.description: Preliminary unselected, strict-coverage, oracle-assisted p=1 breadth ensemble
meta.scientific_status: preliminary; optimizer convergence must be established before manuscript use
meta.optimizer: deterministic coarse grid plus L-BFGS-B; direct P(opt)
qualifications: P(opt) optimisation knows the exact optimum and is an oracle-assisted upper bound.
This broad ensemble tests p=1 only and does not establish depth scaling.
The one-sided diagonal oracle is shared but is not a demonstrated 2-local hardware encoding.
CX values are analytic resource proxies, not backend-transpiled gate counts.
A denser-grid stress test on seed 3 changed individual optima; use qwoa_optimizer_stability.json.
